subject: System Design
title: WebSockets: Persistent Connections
description: A 60-second lesson on WebSockets: Persistent Connections.

hook.text: In a chat app, the server needs to push messages to you instantly. HTTP's request-response model can't do that.

buildup.text: WebSockets upgrade an HTTP connection into a full-duplex channel. Both sides can send data anytime.

discovery.text: Chat apps, live sports scores, and collaborative editors all use WebSockets for real-time updates.

twist.text: WebSocket connections are stateful and long-lived. Load balancing them requires sticky sessions.

climax.text: WebSockets add real-time capability at the cost of connection management complexity.

punchline.text: Two-way communication over a single persistent connection.

quiz.question: What makes WebSockets different from HTTP?
options: Both client and server can send data at any time
